g.title: j3868591447
g.text: Comment as-tu réussi à la convaincre de changer d'avis concernant Albrecht? Tu fais des miracles! Peut-être devraient-ils te vénérer toi plutôt que Sol et Lua.

g.title: j342253044->j3868591447

g.title: j4075672050
g.text: Je n'avais jamais su qu'elle souffrait encore au quotidien. Elle le cache comme si de rien n'était. Elle n'en a parlé qu'à toi. Tu as en quelque sorte comblé un fossé entre nous.

g.title: j342253044->j4075672050

g.title: j4228735469
g.text: Je n'ai appris son histoire que récemment. Elle ne me l'avait jamais racontée avant de te la confier. Tu as en quelque sorte comblé un fossé entre nous.

g.title: j342253044->j4228735469

g.title: j3158677280
g.text: Rien de nouveau. Je passe chaque instant à me retenir de m'arracher le visage à coups de griffes, tant je désire ardemment la faire taire.

g.title: j1933884394

g.title: j349703282
g.text: I wonder if she realizes that my goading has turned from honest annoyance into teasing in good fun?

g.title: j424902374
g.text: I must admit I do not blame you in the slightest. And not simply because she is gorgeous. I have eyes. That woman has more compassion in her than I would have expected to survive to her age.

g.title: j2300166066
g.text: Bah. It is that kind of language that led to the rise of the Orokin Empire. That is a mistake this System should never make twice.

g.title: j2057004046
g.text: I admit I am one of the fools she speaks of, who cannot wrap their minds around living in such a way, day in and day out.

g.title: j120477537
g.text: To think her family threw her onto the streets. Her. Marie. That Marie. The one with more compassion in her than should be possible?!

g.title: j2933620971
g.text: They know my... secret. The truth of my taking of the serum willingly.

g.title: j1460520493
g.text: I commend you for braving that poor madman. He needs the company. And the compassion.

g.title: j910777340
g.text: Yet you shut him out. Shame on you.

g.title: j1695530978
g.text: He spoke to me of the Tenno child he had been hearing. And how he does not hear him any longer.

g.title: j1584480695
g.text: I knew shockingly little of what had been done to him. It was not until he told you, that he had the willingness to tell me.

g.title: j4085553423
g.text: I tease. I am growing oddly fond of them, despite my renewed commitment to shut out their criticism of my decisions in life.

g.title: j632232542
g.text: I expected them to greet my penitence with mockery, with jeers of "finally, he sees the light" or "we told you so." Anything but. They have hardly made mention of it.

g.title: j1397115854
g.text: ...if that does not yet preclude me from drowning myself in it.

g.title: j3160362414
g.text: I hope so. It is too much fun to pester her. Watching her grow angry and shout at me in her native tongue is my new favorite sport.

g.title: j1329138762
g.text: How can she maintain such composure? Let alone compassion? I think I would have gone as mad as the priest in her condition.

g.title: j1498110484
g.text: I cannot describe to you my desire to use a Helminth to travel back in time to murder her entire family. Slowly. But she would likely object to that.
